description: This Java class demonstrates the use of pre-3.0 Android view animation classes to create various animated UI effects, including fade, move, rotate, scale, and combined animations, with setup for button-triggered animations.

classes.name: ViewAnimations
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating view animations with buttons and checkboxes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons and animations.

methods.name: setupAnimation
methods.description: Configures button click to start specified animation, either from code or resource.
